subject.title: Dashboard: inter-widget pub/sub — a tab-scoped, parent-brokered message bus

question: Should OpenClaw accept tab-scoped pub/sub for sandboxed dashboard custom widgets after the bridge lifecycle bug, dependency approval/removal, stacked-base blockers, and real behavior proof are resolved?
rationale: This changes how isolated custom widgets can communicate and adds a manifest capability plus external dependency graph surface, so final acceptance needs product/security intent beyond a mechanical fix.

options.title: Fix and re-review
options.body: Require bridge rekeying, dependency authorization or removal, base-stack refresh, and real browser proof before considering merge.

options.title: Pause the dashboard stack
options.body: Keep this PR open but wait until the prerequisite custom-widget stack is merged or intentionally narrowed before reviewing pub/sub further.

options.title: Close the direction
options.body: Close this PR and the linked feature if maintainers decide widget-to-widget pub/sub should not ship in the bundled dashboard surface.

recommendation.title: Fix and re-review
recommendation.body: Require bridge rekeying, dependency authorization or removal, base-stack refresh, and real browser proof before considering merge.
